title: External credential vault and integration gating
goal: Remove plaintext external credentials and keep every unverified provider disabled until encrypted lifecycle verification passes

in: Social OAuth credential persistence, migration or revocation, encryption, rotation, refresh, disconnect, logging, and provider gating
out: Enabling providers before credential and lifecycle acceptance passes

acceptance_criteria: No plaintext access or refresh token is persisted or emitted to logs
Existing plaintext credentials are migrated safely or revoked with recorded disposition
Encrypted store, rotation, refresh, disconnect, and log-redaction tests pass
Social OAuth and other unverified providers remain disabled until their acceptance evidence is recorded

Audit baseline superseded: the organization social OAuth callback no longer constructs persistence data containing plaintext access_token/refresh_token; it persists encrypted envelopes only via buildOrganizationCredentialPayload and fails closed on encryption errors.

progress.summary: First bounded implementation slice complete: inventory recorded, encrypted-at-rest vault boundary implemented (encrypted-only writes, fail-closed reads, log redaction), organization OAuth callback persists encrypted envelopes only, additive forward-only migration authored (unapplied, CP-051) with planned manifest, focused Vitest/ESLint/migration validation pass. No provider was enabled; social OAuth and analytics remain disabled through RELEASE-008.
completed: Inventoried every external OAuth credential write/read path and recorded disposition: app/api/social/oauth/{start,callback}/route.ts, lib/integrations/token-vault.ts + provider-catalog.ts, app/api/venue/integrations/route.ts, app/api/admin/content-hub/{integrations,overview,analytics}/route.ts + integrations/sync/route.ts, lib/services/organization-social-integrations.service.ts, and supabase/functions/{social-oauth,social-analytics}/index.ts.

Reworked lib/integrations/token-vault.ts into an encrypted-only boundary: writes never touch legacy venue_social_integrations plaintext columns (dual-write retired), reads fail closed (legacy key_version=0 copies, tampered or wrong-key envelopes, and malformed bytes resolve to null — never to raw token text), server-only key access retained, and audit metadata is redacted through redactCredentialLog before persistence.

Organization social OAuth callback now persists encrypted envelopes only (buildOrganizationCredentialPayload) and fails the connect when encryption fails instead of degrading to plaintext persistence.

Authored additive forward-only migration supabase/migrations/20260921000000_intg007_encrypted_social_credential_vault.sql (SUPABASE_TELEMETRY off, superset of the active chain, planned manifest in docs/engineering/migration-validation/) revoking client column SELECT on organization_social_integrations.access_token/refresh_token and revoking legacy plaintext copies (org + venue source columns and key_version=0 vault bytes). NOT applied — CP-051 manual apply is hosted and out of scope.

Added focused Vitest coverage __tests__/integrations/intg007-credential-vault.test.ts (16 tests): no plaintext persisted/emitted, fail-closed decryption, rotation, refresh/disconnect semantics on the vault contract, log redaction, venue-route API-surface compatibility, and a callback source plaintext guard.
Created pending handoffs HF-INTG-007-ADMIN, HF-INTG-007-VENUE, HF-INTG-007-SOCIAL so the legacy plaintext reads outside this lane are removed before the migration applies.

Admin lane: drop access_token/refresh_token selects in the four content-hub routes and switch sync eligibility to envelope/expiry presence (HF-INTG-007-ADMIN).
Venue lane: remove the legacy refresh_token select and vault fallback in POST refresh (HF-INTG-007-VENUE).
Social lane: move social-oauth/social-analytics Edge Functions to encrypted envelope persistence + server-side decrypt (HF-INTG-007-SOCIAL).
Provide credential-vault evidence and provider enablement status to RELEASE-008; enable nothing until encrypted lifecycle acceptance evidence passes.
blockers: Social OAuth and affected providers must remain disabled through RELEASE-008 until credential migration or revocation and encrypted lifecycle verification pass.
Hosted migration apply and Edge Function redeployment are out of band (CP-051); the authored migration remains unapplied in this environment.

app/api/venue/integrations/route.ts, app/api/admin/content-hub/* routes, and supabase/functions/social-oauth|social-analytics still reference legacy plaintext columns and are outside the INTG-007 working set; handoffs created and pending.
